title: Loan Accounting Calendar Convention — Days Past Due When an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Installment Falls Due on a Weekend
content:
**Convention.** The days an Equipment & Vehicle Loans late installment counts as past due are counted from its due date, except that a due date falling on a Saturday is counted from the following Monday, two days later, and a due date falling on a Sunday is counted from the following Monday, one day later.

## Where the count starts

| Weekday of the installment's due date | Days past due are counted from |
|---|---|
| Monday to Friday | the due date itself |
| Saturday | the following Monday, two days after the due date |
| Sunday | the following Monday, one day after the due date |

## Hypothetical illustrations (booking date Monday 22 March)

| Due date | Counted from | Days past due on the booking date |
|---|---|---|
| Friday 5 March | Friday 5 March | 17 |
| Saturday 6 March | Monday 8 March | 14 |
| Sunday 7 March | Monday 8 March | 14 |
| Monday 8 March | Monday 8 March | 14 |

The count of days past due is the number of calendar days from the day the count starts to the booking date.
